notes: Editor fixes + post-generation modal. (1) The Timeline inspector now includes Alignment (left/center/right) and a Wrap toggle — they were previously buried under '⋯ All controls'. (2) Shapes (and any text/image/video layer) can now be deleted straight from the Content rail via a ✕ button; the rail + inspector refresh so the deletion shows immediately (before, the rail kept a stale row so it looked like nothing happened). (3) Wrap already defaults to no-wrap on generation; legacy scenes saved with wrap can now be toggled off with the new inspector control. (4) Rendering now ends with a modal that previews the finished video plus Download / TikTok / Instagram, replacing the old timeline download/share icons.
